## Overview

Online platforms, spreadsheets, surveys, transcripts, and public sources often contain useful data, but they are rarely organized in a way that makes analysis straightforward. Sun Data Analytics helps clients collect, clean, document, and stage those materials so they can be inspected, refreshed, analyzed, and used in reports.

The goal is not just to gather data, but to create a cleaner starting point with documented assumptions, source limitations, and repeatable steps.

## Data Collection Use Cases

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### YouTube Analytics and Platform Exports

For clients who have useful platform data but need help turning exports into cleaner, analysis-ready tables. This can include audience metrics, video performance data, revenue files, geography, subscriber trends, and other recurring exports.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Subtitles, Chat Logs, and Stream Text

For clients who want to analyze what happens inside streams, videos, or other text-heavy media. This can include subtitle files, chat logs, transcript preparation, timestamp cleanup, speaker or source labeling, and organization for later coding or classification.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Surveys, Transcripts, and Open-Ended Responses

For clients who need research material prepared before analysis. This can include survey cleanup, transcript formatting, open-ended response preparation, field definitions, and source notes for qualitative or mixed-methods analysis.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Public Web and Media Sources

For clients who need repeatable collection from public sources where appropriate. This can include source tracking, scrape preparation, refresh workflows, documentation of limitations, and storage structures for later reporting.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Messy Spreadsheets and Internal Files

For clients who already have useful files but need them cleaned, standardized, merged, or reshaped. This can include column cleanup, field definitions, duplicate checks, missing-value review, and conversion into stable source tables.
:::
::::
